Jared Kim: Candidate (Marie Ortiz) asked for two things: shes bringing a small service dog, and wants a quiet corner away from open seating. Interview day is 2024-08-02, hybrid loop with an in-person whiteboard at 10:30 PT.
Lina P.: Thanks for flagging. We need Facilities to pre-clear and mark an ADA table and confirm any building policies for animals. Also who will be the on-site host?
People Ops: I can host morning and handle reception check-in. Marie also asked about a low-scent lunch option and a private lactation-friendly space. Noted.
Reception Bot: Visitor guidance: we require service animal documentation per policy. Reception will ask for the candidates service animal ID and the animal will get a special sticker. Will hold dog water bowl at front desk if requested.
Facilities: We can reserve Corner Suite D (quiet, near meeting rooms) and add an "ADA table, low-traffic" tag. I'll also put out a small mat and a water bowl. Housekeeping to avoid strong-scent cleaners that morning.
Jared Kim: Great. Also Marie will attend half the loop remotely (joining two panels over Zoom) and come in-person for the whiteboard and onsite UX session. Can IT pre-create a meeting room with dual camera + mic and a laptop loaner for screen-sharing?
IT-Ops Bot: AV booking check:
```
room.reserve("Corner Suite D", date="2024-08-02", av_setup="dual-camera + speaker-mic") => confirmed
loaners.get_available(device_type="laptop", date="2024-08-02") => [LOANER-54]
loaners.reserve("LOANER-54", assignee="Marie Ortiz") => reserved
```
People Ops: We'll also need to update the calendar invite with hybrid dial-in instructions and note that there's a service animal. I'll send Marie a pre-visit email with where to check in and what to expect (sticker, low-scent note).
Lina P.: Meal options  low-scent vegetarian boxed lunches, no nuts, labeled. Lactation room reserved (Room L1) 12:00-13:00.
Jared Kim: One more operational ask  Marie needs a quiet laptop for her whiteboard demo with offline repo. IT, can loaner be imaged with the repo pre-cloned and network disabled for the exercise?
IT-Ops Bot: Can image LOANER-54 with repo and set a local user. Network egress will be disabled. VPN not needed. ETA imaging: same-day morning.
People Ops: Travel stipend note: candidate is local but asked for commuter reimbursement; we cover $40. I'll add expense instructions to confirmation. Also Marie indicated she may need extra time between interviews due to dog care; I'll pad the schedule with a 15-min buffer after the whiteboard.
Facilities: Signage added to Corner Suite D: "Quiet Room  Service animal friendly area". Reception script updated: "Ask for ID, provide visitor sticker, direct to Corner Suite D, call Jared Kim when arrived."
Jared Kim: Thanks everyone. I'll be waiting in lobby at 10:05 to escort Marie and her service dog. Please post final confirmation here once imaging and room booking are done.
IT-Ops Bot: LOANER-54 imaging complete and loaner reserved. Room and AV confirmed.
People Ops: Confirmation sent to Marie with parking, check-in, low-scent note, lactation room, reimbursement, and padded schedule. Closing checklist: room reserved, loaner imaged, reception briefed, dietary noted, signage printed. :white_check_mark:
